say:1:1130407001:1.text: That's right. I'm inspecting all weapons and equipment for the festival.
say:1:1130407001:1.source_cn: 是的。武器和装备的检查和保养确认完毕——
say:1:1130407001:1.male: That's right. I'm inspecting all weapons and equipment for the festival.
say:1:1130407001:1.female: That's right. I'm inspecting all weapons and equipment for the festival.

say:2:1130407002:1.text: It's my job to make sure it all works when it counts the most.
say:2:1130407002:1.source_cn: 我得确保它们在关键时刻能够正常运作。
say:2:1130407002:1.male: It's my job to make sure it all works when it counts the most.
say:2:1130407002:1.female: It's my job to make sure it all works when it counts the most.

say:3:1130407003:1.text: It's also vital that food and water stores are well-stocked. Strong warriors need hearty meals to keep up their strength!
say:3:1130407003:1.source_cn: 食物和水要储备充足，需要确保所有人的饮食需求得到满足。
say:3:1130407003:1.male: It's also vital that food and water stores are well-stocked. Strong warriors need hearty meals to keep up their strength!
say:3:1130407003:1.female: It's also vital that food and water stores are well-stocked. Strong warriors need hearty meals to keep up their strength!
